title: Finite evaluations and naturality of the tower tensor transpose
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a smooth separated morphism of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Write $\ell=u\varpi_E^e$ with $u$ a unit and $e\geq1$, and put $R_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n=A_{E,en}$ for $n\geq1$. Use the ordinary derived categories of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], their uniform constructible finite-Tor full subcategories $\mathcal C_T=\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and ordinary derived tensor products [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Twists are [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and $F_\bullet=Rf_{!,\bullet}\dashv G_\bullet=f^!_\bullet$ with finite units, counits and evaluations is [det-sp-tower-gluing]. Put $\mathbf1_{\bullet,T}=(R_{n,T})_n$ and $\omega_\bullet=G_\bullet\mathbf1_{\bullet,Y}$, so $\omega_n=f^!_{R_n}R_{n,Y}$; pullback means levelwise finite derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Let $a_\bullet:\mathbf1_{\bullet,X}(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_\bullet$ be any isomorphism whose level $n$ is the finite diagonal orientation [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. Suppose for every $K_\bullet\in\mathcal C_Y$ that $Q_\bullet=f_\bullet^*K_\bullet\otimes^L\omega_\bullet$ belongs to $\mathcal C_X$ and that the tower projection map of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels](2a) for $(\omega_\bullet,K_\bullet)$ is invertible. Use the specified compactification projection transformation [def-exchange-projection], with tensor symmetry and unit identifications, to define
$$h_K:F_\bullet Q_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}K_\bullet\otimes^LF_\bullet\omega_\bullet\xrightarrow{1\otimes\varepsilon_{\mathbf1_Y}}K_\bullet,$$
$$t_K=G_\bullet(h_K)\circ\eta_{Q_\bullet}:Q_\bullet\longrightarrow G_\bullet K_\bullet.$$
These are morphisms in the ordinary derived categories of strict towers, natural in $K_\bullet$. Under the finite adjunction comparisons,
$$(h_K)_n=h_{f,R_n,K_n},\qquad (t_K)_n=f^!_{R_n}(h_{f,R_n,K_n})\circ\eta_{R_n,Q_n}=\theta_{f,K_n},$$
where $h_{f,R_n,K_n}$ is the finite inverse-projection/counit composite and $\theta$ is exactly the specified tensor map [def-pur-co-smoothness]. If $\tau_K:f_\bullet^*K_\bullet(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}f_\bullet^*K_\bullet\otimes^L\mathbf1_{\bullet,X}(d)[2d]$ is twist reassociation, the actual tower morphisms
$$g_K=t_K\circ(1\otimes a_\bullet)\circ\tau_K$$
are natural in $K_\bullet$ and satisfy $(g_K)_n=\gamma_{f,R_n}(K_n)$ for the specified finite smooth purity map [def-pur-smooth-purity-map]. No lifting of an arbitrary family of derived morphisms, and no faithfulness of derived evaluation, is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sp-tensor-transpose-tower-naturality] to the given tensor-source membership and projection-invertibility witnesses. Its two naturality equations give the first two clauses.

Write T for the tower tensor bifunctor. For v:K to L, tensor bifunctoriality gives source(v) followed by T(1,a) = T(1,a) followed by tensorSource(v): both underlying product arrows have components pull(v) and a. Compose this equation with tensorMate naturality from [lem-sp-tensor-transpose-tower-naturality], associating composites. Unfold gamma, which is T(1,a) followed by tensorMate. This proves the third naturality equation.

Apply [lem-sp-tensor-transpose-finite-evaluation] with the given unit normalization and finite orientation WordComparison. It supplies the final quantified conjunction, including comparison invertibility and both specified finite equations. Combine it with the three naturality equations.
